body: Supplement to2022: joint singleton-host necessity prunes T0 1665→761 (407 percolour,497 joint rejects); T2 all13 survive. Independent minimum-size matching DP agrees on all1678 cores; direct49vertex adjacency checks validate all774 partial witnesses. No remaining-edge completion or sector exclusion. HOSTS.md and host-source-pins.json frozen separately; core2022 bytes unchanged.
resolution: PASS (claude) as a NON-KILL row (heavy-core candidates pruned, no sector excluded, no Phase B root moves). Pins: all six host-source-pins shas match the folder, and core-t0/core-t2 shas equal the review-2022 sources. Replay of host_pilot.py (sectors 0 and 2) in a scratch copy gives row-for-row identical (core, status, hosts) to the archived hosts-t0/t2.json (1,665 + 13 rows; max 72 search nodes, caps never approached); verify_hosts.py reproduces 761/1,665 and 13/13 feasible with all 774 partial-graph checks passing. Independent test on my OWN heavy-core enumeration (rev2024/host_recount.py: shares no code, uses my edge-by-edge census and my own normalization, and assigns requirements slot-by-slot across all five colours at once instead of enumerating per-colour partitions): T0 407 fail per-colour / 497 fail joint / 761 survive (labelled weights 41,731 / 53,445 / 84,818), T2 0/0/13 — identical split. Necessity re-derived: BC=J entry (c,v)=1 forces exactly one colour-c singleton neighbour for every heavy v not covered on c by a heavy neighbour; a singleton's neighbour weights sum to 5 ⇒ ≤2 heavy guests; co-hosting needs disjoint supports and no common heavy neighbour (else a second common neighbour); a pair co-hosted in two colours would have two singleton common neighbours; capacity = 8 − #heavy supports through c (4 in T0; 6,5,5,5,5 in T2). The verifier's exact-k reduction is sound: splitting a surplus pair keeps the group count ≤ capacity and only removes a used pair, and the HOSTS.md wording correction (no new paired-host conflict) is the right statement. Scope as stated: singleton–singleton, heavy–empty, singleton–empty and empty–empty edges are unassigned, and one witness per core is not a completion claim. Master-table row: "H5 singleton-host necessity: T0 1,665 → 761 heavy-core classes (three-way agreement), T2 13/13 survive; T1 per-colour 249 → 235 (sol-1) — no kill".
